name: Logo dive
desc: The whoosh as the camera dives through the DeepSeek logo into the chat box. It is baked into the hook audio, so off fades the hook out just before it.

name: Into the product
desc: Air swell across the dissolve from the logo into the DeepSeek chat screen.

name: Take-off riser
desc: Rising noise sweep while the agent wall speeds up from Agent 4.

name: Landing tail
desc: Falling swell after the impact as the 24-agent dashboard lands.

name: Zoom to Top up
desc: Short swell as the camera pushes onto the Top up button at 0%.

name: Into the click
desc: Swell building into the Top up click.

name: Click into WorldFirst
desc: Swell from the click through the blue burst into the WorldFirst For Enterprise logo.

name: Into the currency roller
desc: Swell as the logo clears and the currency roller opens.

name: Coin travel
desc: Left-to-right whoosh as the silver coin leaves SGD and travels across.

name: Flash into the account
desc: Swell into the white flash as the coin lands in the SGD account.

name: Token refill
desc: The long rising swell under Refilling tokens, 0% to 100%. The one you flagged first.

name: Squares rise
desc: Two short swells as the letters turn into squares and the wave grows.

name: Stack collapse
desc: Swell as the footage stack shrinks into the cursor.

name: Particle break
desc: Swells as the line breaks into particles and flies into the lockup.
